method: Deterministic rsID-only hash 1/64; source cohort file non-palindromic SNPs with finite 0..1 frequencies; exclude eligible duplicate sampled rsIDs; compare |EAF_UKB-EAF_TG| to |EAF_UKB-(1-EAF_TG)|. Descriptive, no causal or probabilistic inference.
limitations: UKB and TwinGene are different populations with differing frequencies; rare variants, sample QC and selection influence results. Frequencies may themselves be processed or inverted and do not independently prove beta sign or effect allele. LD means markers not independent.
